note: Disclosure strings are MEASURED FACTS derived from P4's measured shared-state table (xr-browser/docs/spike-identity/measured-shared-state.md), not promises (L5). Each string has an `evidence` sibling pointing at the measured row + citable file:line at the pin. Localizable: additional locales add sibling keys under `strings`. Vocab-lint clean (no banned claims).

identity_isolates_storage.text: Each identity keeps its own cookies, cache, and site storage in a separate partition.

identity_isolates_network_context.text: Each identity gets its own network context, so proxy and connection settings can differ per identity.

identity_isolates_renderer.text: Pages from different identities never share the same renderer process.

ephemeral_writes_nothing.text: An ephemeral identity keeps its data in memory only; it has no on-disk path, so it writes no site data to disk.

dns_is_shared.text: Domain name lookups are handled by one resolver shared across the whole browser, so which sites you visit can be correlated across identities at the DNS layer.

permissions_are_profile_shared.text: Site permission choices are stored per site for the whole profile, so granting a permission to a site in one identity can be visible to that site in another identity.

history_and_credentials_are_profile_shar.text: History, bookmarks, and saved passwords are stored once per profile and are not separated by identity.

runtime_pending.text: These descriptions come from reading the browser engine's source at a fixed version; they have not yet been confirmed by running the browser.
